class.name: OcgMessageReport
class.brief_description: Container for alert messages, sorted according to their gravity.
class.description: ! Container for alert messages, sorted according to their gravity. ! ! For each gravity level, alerts are stored in simple list. ! If alert being added can be merged with another alert of the same ! type already in the list, it is merged and not added to the list. ! ! This class is intended to be used as follows: ! ! - In the process of execution, algorithm fills report by alert objects ! using methods AddAlert() ! ! - The result can be queried for presence of particular alert using ! methods HasAlert() ! ! - The reports produced by nested or sequentially executed algorithms ! can be collected in one using method Merge() ! ! - The report can be shown to the user either as plain text with method ! Dump() or in more advanced way, by iterating over lists returned by GetAlerts() ! ! - Report can be cleared by methods Clear() (usually after reporting) ! ! Message_PrinterToReport is a printer in Messenger to convert data sent to messenger into report

method.name: Message_Report
method.description: Empty constructor

method.name: AddAlert
method.description: Add alert with specified gravity. This method is thread-safe, i.e. alerts can be added from parallel threads safely.

method.name: GetAlerts
method.description: Returns list of collected alerts with specified gravity

method.name: HasAlert_1
method.description: Returns true if specific type of alert is recorded

method.name: HasAlert_2
method.description: Returns true if specific type of alert is recorded with specified gravity

method.name: IsActiveInMessenger
method.description: Returns true if a report printer for the current report is registered in the messenger

method.name: ActivateInMessenger
method.description: Creates an instance of Message_PrinterToReport with the current report and register it in messenger

method.name: UpdateActiveInMessenger
method.description: Updates internal flag IsActiveInMessenger. It becomes true if messenger contains at least one instance of Message_PrinterToReport.

method.name: Clear_1
method.description: Clears all collected alerts

method.name: Clear_2
method.description: Clears collected alerts with specified gravity

method.name: Clear_3
method.description: Clears collected alerts with specified type

method.name: SetActiveMetric
method.description: Sets metrics to compute when alerts are performed

method.name: ClearMetrics
method.description: Removes all activated metrics

method.name: Limit
method.description: Returns maximum number of collecting alerts. If the limit is achieved, first alert is removed, the new alert is added in the container.

method.name: SetLimit
method.description: Sets maximum number of collecting alerts.

method.name: SendMessages_1
method.description: Sends all collected alerts to messenger.

method.name: SendMessages_2
method.description: Dumps collected alerts with specified gravity to messenger. Default implementation creates Message_Msg object with a message key returned by alert, and sends it in the messenger.

method.name: Merge_1
method.description: Merges data from theOther report into this

method.name: Merge_2
method.description: Merges alerts with specified gravity from theOther report into this

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
